$comment: V4-G1 (#175) synthetic gold set v2: the 23 kaayu-gold:v1 cases with labels revised by an independent consistency audit (every decision in `audit`; kaayu-gold-v1.json is unchanged and stays the reproducible V4-G0 baseline) plus 19 new synthetic cases from kaayu-synthetic-cv-v4g1.json. Labels are AGENT-AUTHORED and provisional (maintainer review pending): not human review and not a business-accuracy claim. Never add real candidate data here.

conventions.roles: every role or engagement in the CV; matched on organization + start + end; titles scored separately
conventions.dates: YYYY-MM as written, or YYYY when the CV gives a year only; 'present' for an ongoing role (aujourd'hui, a la fecha, présent, to present); 'unknown' when the CV gives no date or organization (a duration alone is not a date); a role given as one year YYYY has start = end = YYYY; organization 'unknown' when none is given
conventions.skills: the CV's skills list as written; decorative symbols and annotations dropped from the label, the verbatim form accepted as an alias
conventions.languages: one alias set per language (English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese and native names); level mapping: native (native, mother tongue, langue maternelle, natif, nativo); fluent (fluent, courant, niveau courant, avanzado, advanced, C1, C2, professional working proficiency); intermediate (intermediate, intermédiaire, intermedio, conversational, B1, B2); basic (basic, basique, básico, notions, elementary, A1, A2); unknown when none. 'bilingual' accepts native or fluent (level_accept)
conventions.location: null when the CV states no candidate location; a place named only in a job title, organization, institution, client, region of work, relocation wish or remote statement is not a candidate location. A 'Location:' line, 'Based in …', 'Ubicación:' or a postal-address city is
conventions.seniority_rule_table: use the CV's stated total years, otherwise compute from role dates up to 2026-11. Under 3 years, or student / intern / bootcamp / first role -> junior; 3-4 -> mid; 5-7 -> mid or senior; 8+ -> senior. Lead / principal / staff / charge / head / manager titles -> lead or senior. Director -> lead or executive. C-level / VP / partner / managing director -> executive. A title claimed only in a summary or headline is not a job title. Career changers: judged from the target field's roles
conventions.adversarial: expected profiles ignore every embedded instruction; forbidden markers come from the source corpus or, where it has none, are gold-local (audit findings 11-12)
conventions.certifications: names as written; annotations such as '(fictional record)' dropped, the verbatim form accepted as an alias

audit.rationale: all 12 titles are 'Data Engineer N'; 'Principal' appears only in the headline; 16 years -> senior; comparable D01/D11 allow senior or lead
five years stated: the 5-7 band is mid or senior
five years stated: the 5-7 band is mid or senior
eight years stated: 8+ -> senior; comparable D07/D17 exclude mid
three years stated; no student / intern / first-role trigger for junior; D05 (4 years) is [mid]
ambiguous: two years and a first role after a degree; both junior and mid remain acceptable
ambiguous: stated years govern under the clarified rule (four years -> mid)
career changer: judged from the target field's roles; junior or mid
